handoff.plan:
starter_template:
  mode: none
  rationale: stack_the_tower shares the win/lose (10 in 30s) and tap-drop input, but its single
    fixed-size block, tilt check and no claw diverge from our variable-size product sprites, 30%
    overlap topple rule, claw rig, next-item preview and tower scrolling; build from scratch and
    borrow its win/lose, runtime-prefab and freeze-on-land patterns.
mechanic_refs:
  - mechanic_id: stack_drop_balance
    borrowed_elements:
      - win by stacking 10 blocks before the 30s timer expires, lose on timeout or bad drop
      - runtime prefab.instantiate for each dropped block
      - landed blocks freeze static so the stack stays stable
      - intro overlay tap-to-start and result overlay tap-to-retry
      - countdown timer HUD next to the stack-count score
game_type:
  camera_feed: visible
  ar_tracking: none
  core_loop_seconds: 3
  total_duration_seconds: 30
camera_feed_constraints:
  tracking_type: none
  tracking_range: not applicable - live camera feed is only the backdrop
  user_image_visible: true
  composition: none
mechanic:
  class: other
  description: "Claw-drop stacking: a claw swings left-right holding a Mamamy product; tap drops it
    straight down (rotation and x locked). If at least 30% of the upper item's width overlaps the
    item below (and a wider item's center stays over it) it freezes and scores +1 floor; otherwise
    it topples and the player loses. Win by stacking 10 floors before the 30s countdown ends; lose
    on timeout or topple."
  parameters:
    time_limit_sec: 30
    min_overlap: 0.3
    item_types: 9
    swing_speed_px_per_sec: 160
    scroll: tower slides down when its top passes y=-127
    win_floors: 10
screens:
  - name: Intro
    role: intro
    initial_visible: true
    layout:
      - id: intro_logo
        element: MAMAMY TOWER logo image
        position: center, y=+90
        size: 505x194
        kind: decoration
      - id: intro_hint
        element: instruction text
        position: center, y=-40
        content: Xếp đủ 10 tầng trong 30 giây!
        kind: hud
      - id: intro_button
        element: pink pill button with text CHẠM ĐỂ CHƠI
        position: center, y=-170
        size: 300x70
        kind: button
        interactive: true
  - name: Gameplay
    role: gameplay
    initial_visible: true
    layout:
      - id: claw
        element: claw image swinging horizontally
        position: top, y=+420, x in [-220,160]
        size: 251x201
        kind: playable
      - id: held_item
        element: current product hanging under the claw
        position: under claw, top at y=+436
        kind: playable
        interactive: true
      - id: tower
        element: stack of dropped product sprites
        position: bottom, ground top y=-400
        kind: playable
      - id: next_panel
        element: next-item preview pill with thumbnail
        position: right edge, y=+408
        size: 181x158
        kind: hud
      - id: score_badge
        element: pink badge TẦNG + floors as n/10
        position: top-left (-266,+423)
        size: 140x100
        kind: hud
      - id: timer_badge
        element: plum badge GIÂY + seconds left
        position: top-left (-116,+423)
        size: 140x100
        kind: hud
      - id: popup_text
        element: +1 / HOÀN HẢO! popup above the landed item
        position: above tower top
        kind: hud
  - name: Result
    role: result
    initial_visible: false
    layout:
      - id: result_dim
        element: dark translucent full-screen dim
        position: full screen
        kind: result
        translucent: true
        opacity: 0.55
      - id: result_card
        element: "white rounded card: title THÀNH CÔNG! (win) or HẾT GIỜ! / THÁP ĐỔ RỒI! (lose), floors
          x/10"
        position: center, y=+40
        size: 420x380
        kind: result
      - id: retry_button
        element: pink pill button CHƠI LẠI
        position: center, y=-230
        size: 300x70
        kind: button
        interactive: true
interactions:
  - kind: record_start_reset
    trigger: APJS.EventType.RecordStart
    response: Destroy all spawned items, reset score/timer/scroll, show intro
    state_change: any -> INTRO
    target:
      scope: none
      rationale: global lifecycle event
  - kind: screen_transition
    trigger: tap anywhere while INTRO
    response: Hide intro overlay, start timer, spawn first item under the claw
    state_change: INTRO -> AIMING
    target:
      scope: screen_element
      screen_element_ids:
        - intro_button
    feedback:
      visual: intro overlay disappears and the first product drops into the claw
  - kind: gameplay_action
    trigger: tap anywhere while AIMING
    response: "Release the held product: physics on, rotation and x frozen, falls straight down; on
      settle apply the 30% overlap rule"
    state_change: AIMING -> DROPPING -> AIMING (stacked), RESULT win (10th floor) or RESULT lose (toppled)
    target:
      scope: screen_element
      screen_element_ids:
        - held_item
    feedback:
      visual: product falls, lands, +1 / HOÀN HẢO! popup, floor counter increments; claw opens then grips
        next item
  - kind: retry
    trigger: tap anywhere on RESULT after 0.8s
    response: Clear tower, reset score and timer, restart
    state_change: RESULT -> AIMING
    target:
      scope: screen_element
      screen_element_ids:
        - retry_button
    feedback:
      visual: result card hides and a fresh item appears in the claw
assets:
  - id: asset.claw
    role: claw
    description: Purple mechanical claw with red tips (TACH HINH 1, cropped), swings at the top
    is_background: false
    count: 1
    animated: false
    coverage: partial
    interactive_role: addressable_part
    kind: visual
  - id: asset.products
    role: droppable items
    description: Nine cropped Mamamy product sprites (wet wipes x4, dry tissue, laundry pouch, two pump
      bottles, bottle brush set)
    is_background: false
    count: 9
    animated: false
    coverage: partial
    interactive_role: spawnable_pool
    kind: visual
  - id: asset.next_panel
    role: next preview
    description: Pink right-edge pill with double chevron (TACH HINH 2) hosting the next item thumbnail
    is_background: false
    count: 1
    animated: false
    coverage: partial
    interactive_role: decoration
    kind: visual
  - id: asset.logo
    role: title
    description: MAMAMY TOWER bubble-letter logo cropped from TACH HINH 13 without the baked 19 shield
    is_background: false
    count: 1
    animated: false
    coverage: partial
    interactive_role: decoration
    kind: visual
  - id: asset.ui
    role: hud and buttons
    description: "Generated brand-colored UI shapes: pink badge, pink pill button, white card, white
      pixel for tinted dims, soft ground shadow"
    is_background: false
    count: 5
    animated: false
    coverage: partial
    interactive_role: decoration
    kind: visual
random_behaviors:
  - what: next product type
    range: floors 0-3 wipes/tissue only; then 30% bottles/pouch; brush set from floor 9; never two
      narrow-top items in a row
    verify_strategy: log picked item names over several drops via get_script_logs
criteria:
  - category: layout
    check: Claw, HUD badges and intro/result content stay inside 720x1280 with interactive content in
      the TikTok safe zone
  - category: state
    check: Tap on intro starts the timer and puts an item in the claw
  - category: state
    check: Item with >=30% overlap freezes on the tower and floor count increments
  - category: state
    check: Item with <30% overlap topples and the result card shows THÁP ĐỔ RỒI!
  - category: value
    check: Result card shows the same floor count as the HUD
  - category: camera_feed
    check: Live camera feed stays visible behind the game (Camera clearType DEPTH)
  - category: visual
    check: Tower scrolls down when it grows so the drop gap stays visible
  - category: boundary
    check: Timer reaching 0 before 10 floors shows HẾT GIỜ! (lose) with floors n/10
  - category: state
    check: Landing the 10th floor before time runs out shows THÀNH CÔNG! (win)
scene_representation:
  planning_mode: explicit
  decision_summary: "Flat 2D screen-space game over the live camera feed: Screen Images with
    RigidBody2D/BoxCollider2D for items, script-driven claw swing, HUD and overlays as 2D objects."
  space:
    kind: screen
    description: 720x1280 ScreenTransform space, origin at center
  content_form:
    kind: flat_2d
    description: PNG sprites on Screen Images plus 2D Text
  requirements:
    - id: req.drop_stack
      description: Tap drops the held product which stacks on the tower
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.game
      verification_refs:
        - ver.stack
    - id: req.overlap_rule
      description: Item stays if >=30% overlaps the item below, otherwise topples
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.game
      verification_refs:
        - ver.stack
    - id: req.timer
      description: Win at 10 floors within 30s; lose on timeout or topple; result card shows outcome
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.hud
      verification_refs:
        - ver.result
    - id: req.camera
      description: Camera feed visible behind the game
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.camera
      verification_refs:
        - ver.intro
  layers:
    - id: layer.game
      role: gameplay
      description: Claw, held item, tower items, ground collider
      space:
        kind: screen
        description: screen
      content_form:
        kind: flat_2d
        description: flat_2d
      requirement_refs:
        - req.drop_stack
        - req.overlap_rule
    - id: layer.hud
      role: hud and overlays
      description: Score/timer badges, next preview, intro and result overlays
      space:
        kind: screen
        description: screen
      content_form:
        kind: flat_2d
        description: flat_2d
      requirement_refs:
        - req.timer
    - id: layer.camera
      role: backdrop
      description: Live camera feed via existing Camera with DEPTH clear
      space:
        kind: screen
        description: screen
      content_form:
        kind: camera_feed
        description: camera_feed
      requirement_refs:
        - req.camera
  verification:
    - id: ver.intro
      description: capture_preview shows intro over camera feed
      requirement_refs:
        - req.camera
      views_or_states:
        - intro
      success_criteria: |-
        logo and play button visible
        camera feed visible
    - id: ver.stack
      description: interact_by_dsl taps to start and drop several items
      requirement_refs:
        - req.drop_stack
        - req.overlap_rule
      views_or_states:
        - aiming
        - stacked
      success_criteria: |-
        items stack
        floor count increments
    - id: ver.result
      description: wait out the timer or force a topple and screenshot the result card
      requirement_refs:
        - req.timer
      views_or_states:
        - result
      success_criteria: result card with floor count visible
  fallbacks:
    unknown_requirement: adapt_and_verify
    unmet_must: stop_and_explain
plan_type: game

template.rationale: stack_the_tower shares the win/lose (10 in 30s) and tap-drop input, but its single fixed-size block, tilt check and no claw diverge from our variable-size product sprites, 30% overlap topple rule, claw rig, next-item preview and tower scrolling; build from scratch and borrow its win/lose, runtime-prefab and freeze-on-land patterns.

7405500785988993041.title: Confetti Party Burst

7405500795006746640.title: Confetti Sports Burst
